svg.title: Governed human-agent collaboration for supplier invoice validation
svg.desc: AI-augmented workflow with human-led agent operations. Human decision authority above routing and validation. The exception review uses Proponent, Opponent, Chain of Verification, and Judge. Analytics, Integrator, Reporter, and Audit provide support; Attacker runs independent tests outside the invoice case flow. No automated payment approval.
svg.text: Supplier invoice validation with retained human decision authority
Agents prepare bounded evidence and advice; a named person retains the final approval decision.
Routine path: committee skipped if checks suffice • Exception path: Proponent + Opponent → CoVe → Judge → Human decision
AI examines and recommends. Evidence supports the findings. A person makes the decision.
Illustrative target model · public static / scripted examples; no autonomous approvals
